code.purpose: Commands, endpoints, imports, and queries only.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Goal-row color and arrow transitions plus proof-panel entry.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Effectively removes animations and transitions when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Square cobalt action for the single strongest next step.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; background: var(--color-accent, #2457d6); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover, #1945b8); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2457d6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Proof Tab
components.description: Selected route within the shared training-history proof.
components.css: .ds-proof-tab { position: relative; min-height: 80px; padding: 16px; color: var(--color-accent, #2457d6); background: var(--color-surface, #faf9f4); border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-line-soft, #d3d0c6); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; } .ds-proof-tab::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 4px; content: ''; background: var(--color-accent, #2457d6); } .ds-proof-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2457d6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Goal Row
components.description: Full-width goal destination with a cobalt inversion on hover and focus.
components.html: Use with AIConnect a client
components.css: .ds-goal-row { min-height: 82px; padding: 14px 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 24px; color: var(--color-ink, #171714); background: var(--color-bg, #f3f1e9); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line-soft, #d3d0c6); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-goal-row strong { font-size: 28px; } .ds-goal-row svg { width: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-goal-row:hover, .ds-goal-row:focus-visible { color: #fff; background: var(--color-accent, #2457d6); } .ds-goal-row:hover svg, .ds-goal-row:focus-visible svg { transform: translateX(0.35rem); } .ds-goal-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2457d6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Program Fact
components.description: Label-value pair for prompts, commands, endpoints, and outcomes.
components.css: .ds-program-fact { padding: 20px 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 20px; color: var(--color-ink, #171714); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, #aaa89f); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line-soft, #d3d0c6); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-program-fact > span { color: var(--color-faint, #6a6962); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 620; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-program-fact code { overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Flat custom header shared by the homepage and Blume documentation shell.
components.html: trainheroic unofficialDocsConnect MCP
components.css: .ds-site-nav { min-height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; color: var(--color-ink, #171714); background: var(--color-bg, #f3f1e9); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #aaa89f); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-site-nav a { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand { margin-right: auto; font-weight: 710; } .ds-brand span { margin-left: 6px; color: var(--color-muted, #55554f); font-weight: 450; } .ds-nav-action { padding: 0 13px; color: #fff !important; background: var(--color-accent, #2457d6); } .ds-site-nav a:hover:not(.ds-nav-action) { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.35em; } .ds-nav-action:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover, #1945b8); } .ds-site-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #2457d6); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A precise training record opened across AI, terminal, SDK, and export. Warm paper, program rules, compressed type, and one cobalt lane create a direct technical world without borrowing an AI client's identity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm flat paper divided by graphite program rules

rules.name: The One Lane Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only expressive accent.

rules.name: The Literal Mono Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when content is typed, pasted, run, or parsed.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Use rules and tonal shifts instead of shadows or glass effects.

dos: Do lead with the user's goal and show a real TrainHeroic task as proof.
Do keep the hosted MCP route prominent without making one AI client the whole product.
Do use rules, alignment, and type scale to establish hierarchy.
donts: Don't copy another product's navigation or client-specific identity.
Don't use generic card grids, icon bubbles, pills, gradients, or shadows.
Don't assign every audience or product surface a different accent color.
